description: List an artist's songs ranked by popularity. Returns song METADATA (id, title, artist, Genius URL) — NOT lyric text. Example: artist_songs({ artist_id: 1421, limit: 20 })

_apiKey.description: Genius access token (optional — omit to use the platform key)

limit.description: Max number of songs to return (default 20, max 50)

name: artist_songs
title: Artist Songs
